name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Hm? What is this place? Is something here or what?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You went here with Shiorin? An urban legend? Ah, okay, sure. So you actually experienced it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ghost marriage, huh. Ghost marriage... That thing where you pick up a letter and end up marrying a corpse, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh? What the heck—that's scary."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And you actually tried it? I can't believe you... There's no way I could do that."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyway, Shiori ain't here. Let's go, I don't wanna find any weird letters lying around."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What? What're you waiting for?"
Something's on the ground.

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What's this?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No, seriously, what *is* this...?"
(Pick it up)
It feels kind of weird.

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No way you're picking that up, you're unreal. That thing's already giving me the creeps."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How do I put it? It's like... the same vibe as when you bump into a ghost. Kinda like that, but not at the same time. You get me? Nope?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Point is, it's some kinda occult thing. I think."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You think it's got something to do with that other world...? Kinda feels like it, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, maybe that occult girl would know. This kinda stuff's her specialty, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If you're curious, why not ask her? I don't really care either way."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, up to you. For now, why not just take it? C'mon, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You could just take it for now. Who knows, maybe some occult nut's gonna pay good money for it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If it sells, let's split—Wait, never mind. Money's useless to me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, do whatever you want. C'mon, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, yeah, this again. Sure, go ahead."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I don't really get it, but maybe something'll happen if you get 'em all?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Might as well pick it up. Maybe we'll even get some prize or something."
(Pick it up)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Let's go. Doesn't look like Shiorin's here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, an OOPArt. Yeah, it's giving off these weird vibes..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, I just noticed something. Don't they kinda shake when you bring them close together?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "See, look. They're totally vibrating. How does it even do that? Creepy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well, whatever. We've got 'em all now. We should take them to the occult girl."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, maybe they'll blow up once you put 'em all together... Not that I'd know."
(Pick it up)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe just stash it away for now. And be careful with it, mmkay~? Alright, let's go~"
